--- title: "Week 14 - Update" author: "Victoria Sjalim" date: "2026-10-26" format: html execute: freeze: auto --- # What is fix? ## Dimas fix the bug that related to duplication I pulled the github together from Dimas's and mine into the github copies. `https://github.com/Victoriasja18/eris` ## Precision Recall All the validations, including GFA (only with names) and FA (with location) can be found in `matrix.py` script. ### Validation for Simulated GFA ```{bash} # uv run eris -i ../data/EC958_complete_genome.fasta -d ../data/IS_n.mmi -o ../progress/result/dimas_fa -m collapse --merge-synonyms ``` Validation after merging with min identity = 0.75 ::: {#7f50175b .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import matrix as mt import pandas as pd # The simulated GFA was assembled from the chromosome only gt = mt.read_truth(mt.GT_CHROMOSOME, exclude=["ISSen10"]) gfa = mt.read_report("../result/dimas_fix_sim/dimas_fix_sim_report.tsv") summaries = [] for count_copies in (True, False): summary, detail = mt.precision_recall_gfa(gt, gfa, count_copies=count_copies) summaries.append(summary) display(pd.DataFrame(summaries)) # IS where eris and the truth disagree (copies counted) _, detail = mt.precision_recall_gfa(gt, gfa, count_copies=True) detail[(detail["FP"] > 0) | (detail["FN"] > 0)] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ```{=html}
